rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983, 194th General Court)
rules.requirement: This pending Senate bill would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in Massachusetts rental housing. The document does not include the bill text, so its specific prohibitions are not stated.
rules.coverage_conditions: Statewide rental housing as proposed; the document does not specify scope.
rules.citation: Mass. Senate Bill S.2983 (194th General Court), new draft of S.994 and S.1016
rules.quoted_span: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting
rules.conflict_note: Not enacted. Reported favorably by the Joint Committee on Housing on 3/12/2026 and referred to Senate Ways and Means; that is the latest action shown as of retrieval. The bill text is not included, so its substantive provisions are unknown.
